subject: p-prog
title: P.PROG.------MT.INFO.
description: Second diagram on page 474 (TRF(II)-10), paired with PER.PHY.U.FUND × WO.EXP.PRI above. The crossing diagrams how particular-progressionalism structurally meets multi-information at the multi-factor-cyclic-shift scale: P-PROG (particular progressionalism) crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). P-PROG sits at upper-right with the subject-arrow; MT-INFO sits at lower-left as partner-axis. SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular) branches right from the main line and carries RT-DY (reality dynamics). TRS (transition) runs left from the main line and carries POL-CON (political consciousness), which carries P-FC (particular focus). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) drops from the main line and carries AFI (affinity insight) and LK-IMP (linkage implications); LK-IMP carries RE-DOC (redocumentation) and PRI-INFO (principle information), which carries RE-ST (restructuralism).
